title: Building Permits Survey: Final Annual 2025 Data — Phase 65 Toronto application 24 254930 delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Toronto application 24 254930 delivery reporting pack. The final 2025 Building Permits Survey provides place-, county-, state-, and structure-level residential authorization data for housing-pipeline analysis.
key_findings: The annual files report authorized housing units and valuation by permit-issuing geography and structure type.
The May 14 release is the final annual 2025 vintage and should remain distinct from monthly preliminary estimates.
Authorization counts are an upstream housing-stage measure rather than starts, completions, occupancy, availability, or affordability.
why_it_matters: Which records separate Council adoption and infrastructure context from enactment, conditions, building permit, start, completion, and occupancy? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. Housing authorization is one measurable input to local workforce and industrial-growth analysis, provided it remains separate from delivered housing supply.
ftfn_relevance: Strengthens the Finance and Risk and Human Futures evidence layer.
Supports consistent Phoenix, Maricopa, and peer-geography housing-pipeline queries.
Provides a stage-aware companion to local planning, permit, start, completion, and occupancy records.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
Permits authorize construction; they do not prove starts, completions, occupancy, availability, or affordability.
Coverage, imputation, revisions, and permit-issuing geography require explicit treatment.
Residential authorization does not directly measure industrial workforce adequacy or project delivery.
